signals.evidence_text: "demand for it was so high that the entire stock disappeared within minutes"
signals.solution: A small robot duck containing a processing chip manufactured in China.

signals.evidence_text: Preordered mine and can't wait for the little guy to get here. Thanks for the video. Looking forward to your future content.

signals.statement: The commenter has preordered the product and is waiting for delivery.

signals.evidence_text: "With pre-orders piling up ahead of a shipping window before Christmas"
signals.solution: Microduck, an open-source bipedal robot from Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics.
signals.statement: The description states that Microduck has pre-orders ahead of a shipping window before Christmas.

signals.problem: Expresses desire to have one of the featured items.
signals.statement: Expresses desire to have one of the featured items.
